title: 希佩尔海军上将（Admiral Hipper） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. Tall stepped German command tower, a heavy single funnel, two pole masts and four twin positions interpret Admiral Hipper specifically, not Prinz Eugen or an exact refit.
targetArmament: Four twin 203-class main mounts match TARGET counts. Four automatic single 127-class secondary mounts are split into the actual ca_port and ca_starboard banks. Light AA is TARGET-defined, not a historical inventory.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
